messages:
Zoe P: Filed a short postmortem for a metering disruption where our ingestion window alignment moved by one hour due to a DST-related cron change. A handful of reserved and enterprise PAYG customers saw token undercounts for 2026-04-01..2026-04-02. Link: https://redwood.internal/pm/MP-2026-dst-ingest-gap
Hector M: Oof. Is this the cron sharded across regions? Any quick root cause?
Anya V: Yes, the cron used server local time instead of UTC when the ops runbook that touched system time changed hosts. The consumer accepted events but the window filter dropped them. Estimated missing tokens ~4.7M across 42 accounts.
Luis F: I'll take engineering ownership: deploy a change to make the windowing UTC-safe, add a unit test for cron timezone handling, and run a controlled backfill. ETA for patch to staging: 2026-04-05.
Priyanka (acct): I'll own invoice remediation and accounting check. Requesting CSV with: account_id, billing_period_start, billing_period_end, orig_tokens, corrected_tokens, token_delta, suggested_credit_usd, and a short notes column.
billing-bot: JIRA-5234 created: "DST-aligned cron caused metering window drift 2026-04-01..02" Labels: billing, postmortem, cron. Priority: P2.
Zoe P: Action items I propose:
- Engineering fix + staging dry-run + prod backfill -> Hector/Anya/Luis -> due 2026-04-08 EOD
- Corrected deltas CSV + validation report -> Luis F -> due 2026-04-09 EOD
- Invoice corrections + credits + customer comms -> Priyanka -> draft by 2026-04-11, send after accounting sign-off
- Accounting sign-off & audit memo -> Priyanka (acct) -> sign-off by 2026-04-12
- Add monitoring rule for ingestion-window-drift and runbook update -> Hector M -> PR to monitoring by 2026-04-07
Hector M: I'll open the monitoring PR today. Proposed alert: daily_missed_events_percent > 0.2% or shifted_window_detected metric -> paging for oncall. Also will include a check that cron TZ == UTC as a preflight.
Anya V: Backfill validation query (staging) I'll use:
```
SELECT account_id,
  SUM(CASE WHEN event_time BETWEEN '2026-04-01T00:00:00Z' AND '2026-04-02T23:59:59Z' THEN tokens ELSE 0 END) AS corrected_tokens
FROM metering_events_backfill
GROUP BY account_id;
```
I'll also produce a top-20-diff snippet and an md5 checksum of the CSV.
Luis F: Noting risk: some archived shards have delayed replication; if replication lag > 24h we may need manual archival scans which could push timelines by 48h. Will flag if that happens.
Priyanka (acct): For comms: prefer three tiers: automated small-credit notices (<$50), templated email for $50-$500, and personalized outreach for >$500. Also request a short FAQ paragraph explaining the DST cron mismatch and how we calculated credits.
Zoe P: Please add the CSV upload to JIRA-5234 and ping #finance when attached. We'll do a quick sync 2026-04-09 10:00 PT to confirm CSV and draft messaging.
Hector M: PR opened for monitoring here: https://git.internal/redwood/alerts/pull/451 includes runbook snippet and the cron TZ preflight.
billing-bot: JIRA-5234 updated: backfill job started on staging.
Anya V: Completed staging dry-run, uploading sample CSV (top10) and validation log to JIRA-5234. No idempotence issues found on the dry-run.
Luis F: Starting prod backfill now; will attach full CSV when done.
Priyanka (acct): Received sample CSV, looks reasonable. Drafting accounting memo and customer templates; will share in the sync on 4/09.
Zoe P: Thanks team. Keep updates in the JIRA and this thread for quick checks only. Escalate to me if accounting or legal blocks the send. :thumbsup:
